data.define: People who love the same show or band.

misuse.why: It means devoted fans of one thing.

data.l1_hook: Qui aime le plus ce groupe ? "Fandom" ?

native.tip: “fandom” = communauté de fans. Exemple: “The fandom loves this band.”
